VoiceConnection.description: Whether the engine has confirmed the member's media (S33 v2 §10.1).

oneOf.description: The admit is registered; media not confirmed yet.
The engine confirmed the participant (also during a reconnect window).

call_id.description: The DM call (`calls.id`) of a call entry (S34 v2 §20.1); absent in voice channels.

joined_at.description: When the join succeeded (a move resets it).

secure.description: The member's device is in the activated key epoch (S50 `secure_changed`).

self_stream.description: The member holds a screen-share lease (S34 v2 §10.2).

self_video.description: The member holds a camera lease (S34 v2 §10.2).

server_deaf.description: Deafened by a moderator (persistent per space).

server_mute.description: Muted by a moderator (persistent per space).

space_id.description: The channel's space; absent for DM calls.

speak_denied.description: The member lacks SPEAK here; clients show it as muted.
